description: This Dart source file defines the MatchRepository class, which acts as an intermediary between the application's UI or business logic and the MatchService. It handles mapping filter preferences into query parameters and delegates fetching match data to the service.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository responsible for translating filter preferences into query parameters and delegating the data fetch to MatchService.
